label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.75… supports Every occurring thought episode is an…
note: ST I q.75 a.2 co. treats understanding as an operation that the intellectual principle has per se. The premise states that every occurring thought episode is an operation. The passage covers only intellectual thought (understanding); thought in Descartes' broad sense includes sensing and imagining, which this article does not address, and bundle or event ontologies of the mind deny that episodes are someone's doings.
